defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before predictable burst damage to gain a flat damage reduction for the duration.

defensives.name: Renewing Blaze
defensives.usage_rule: Use ahead of a damage spike to recoup a large portion of the damage you take over the following window as healing.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Cast just before a telegraphed raid-wide AoE to reduce incoming area damage for yourself and nearby allies; scout useful spots when learning a fight.

defensives.name: Time Dilation
defensives.usage_rule: Apply to a single endangered target as a superb damage-reduction cooldown; its short cooldown means you can use it regularly rather than hoarding it.

defensives.name: Cauterizing Flame
defensives.usage_rule: Use to remove a dispellable Bleed, Poison, Curse, or Disease and heal the target; it does not trigger its cooldown when nothing is removed, so it can be pre-stored in Stasis for a mass cleanse.
